newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian bourse mixed, stability seen.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian bourse mixed, stability seen.

text.p: Lithuanian shares were quieter on Monday on a mixed trend by the close of trade with dealers expecting stability this week.
"I don't expect major changes this week," said Aurimas Rishka, a broker with Litimpeks bank.
The market has been stuck in the doldrums recently, with the summer holidays impending and the market showing little reaction to recent five-month profit reports.
Indices were mixed with the official list of the top five shares easing 0.16 points to 880.31 but the more wide-ranging group A index of 40 shares advancing 19.89 points to 1899.82.
Turnover on the central market ebbed to 297,000 litas from 390,000 litas. Block trade turnover slipped to 100,000 litas from 285,000 litas.
Official list share Hermis Bank, one of the two leading Lithuanian banks, edged up to 185 litas from 182 litas on trade of 1,850 litas on the central market.
Dealers say the stock has benefited from steady interest and was showing a delayed reaction to recent earnings figures.
"I think it will trade around 185.00 litas to 190.00 litas this week," said one dealer.
The most active share was the Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO), which added 6.49 litas to 6.42 litas and turned over 69,000 litas.
Baltic Shipyard edged up slightly to 7.96 litas from 7.95 litas amid central market turnover of 55,000 litas.
"They have not been doing so well this year and performed poorly last year but it is a company with potential in the long run," said one dealer.
